item.title: AI Executive Order Opens Door to Federal-State Legal Battles

item.title: Federal Circuit Upholds Setting Side of Jury Verdict Where Trade Secrets Not Identified With Sufficient Particularity
item.description: The Federal Circuit recently confirmed the importance of properly identifying the trade secrets underlying a claim under the Ohio Uniform Trade Secrets Act (“OUTSA”) [Ohio Rev. Code §§ 1333.61 et seq.], finding that the plaintiffs’ failure to properly identify the trade secrets entitled the defendant to judgment as a matter of law notwithstanding a jury verdict in the plaintiffs’ favor. item.title: New York State and City Legislative Update- Changes for All Employers in 2025 and 2026
item.description: Takeaways Effective immediately: New bar on New York State employers’ requiring “employment promissory notes” as a condition of employment. Also, an amendment to the New York State Human Rights Law clarifies that an actual or predictable adverse effect of an employer’s practice, regardless of intent, suffices as a prima facie showing of unlawful discrimination. item.title: ACCESS Model- CMMI’s New Technology-Enabled Chronic Care Model
item.description: The Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) recently announced a voluntary, 10-year Medicare payment and service delivery model: Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions (ACCESS) Model. item.title: OpenAI Loses Privacy Gambit: 20 Million ChatGPT Logs Likely Headed to Copyright Plaintiffs
item.description: When OpenAI proposed producing 20 million anonymized ChatGPT logs in the sprawling AI copyright litigation against it, the generative AI behemoth likely assumed it could control what those logs would reveal. That assumption appears to have backfired. item.title: FDA Finds “Significant Data Gaps” for PFAS Used in Cosmetic Products
item.description: As required under the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022 (MoCRA), on December 29, 2025, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) published a Report on the Use of PFAS in Cosmetic Products and Associated Risks.
